text.pages_rule: 12n-1 supply (4n-1); packed 175 content pages, guide p.5 suggests 175 -- blank padding not supplied at the owner's request
text.page_fit_note: master page box 210.0 x 297.0 mm matches the trim within a printer's tolerance; no rescaling
text.content_shift_note: content moved 0.0 mm toward the outer edge and 0.0 mm down: closest live text is now 13.8 mm off the gutter (was 13.8), 5.7 mm from the outer trim (was 5.7) and 6.7 mm from the top trim (their rules: 20 mm gutter, 5 mm trim; tightest page 94, 13.8 mm off the gutter); this page cannot reach 20 mm without pushing the outer margin under 5 mm
text.outline_note: outlined glyphs, text re-laid invisibly (11346 spans)
text.note: kept RGB: the master sets its text in fonts that cannot be embedded (1 Type 3 glyph programs); the pack outlines those glyphs so BookVault's font check passes, and their preflight converts the RGB (guide p.6)

checks.name: Text file page size is 216 x 303 mm
checks.detail: 216.00 x 303.00 mm = 210 x 297 mm trim plus 3 mm bleed (trim + bleed on every edge, their p.5/p.18 formula)

checks.name: Bleed is 3 mm on all four edges
checks.detail: guide p.5 requires 3 mm; media extends 3 mm past the trim on every side

checks.name: Bleed continues the page edge
checks.detail: no point across the cut lines puts a whitish colour against a coloured one (6300 points checked), so no white nick can print

checks.name: Bleed approximates the artwork at the cut
checks.detail: 267 of 6300 points differ by more than 30 units where both sides are coloured detail: the flat smear's limit on artwork that runs along the cut, entirely inside the 3 mm that is trimmed away

checks.name: Page artwork survives assembly
checks.detail: sampled interior pages carry the master's artwork

checks.name: Bleed seam matches the artwork
checks.detail: the smear meets the page with no visible step in the bleed

checks.name: Live text clears their 20 mm gutter
checks.detail: closest live text is 13.8 mm off the gutter (page 94); guide p.3 asks for 20 mm

checks.name: Live text clears their 5 mm trim safety
checks.detail: closest live text is 4.1 mm from the right edge (page 149); their template draws a 5 mm safety line

checks.name: Single pages, portrait
checks.detail: 175 single pages, portrait, all 216.0 mm wide

checks.name: Page count is 4n-1
checks.detail: 175 pages (175 of book); guide p.5: supply one less than a divisible of 4, the production barcode is added to the last page

checks.name: Last page is clear for their barcode
checks.detail: the final page is blank, so the barcode they add lands on nothing

checks.name: Cover pages stripped from the interior
checks.detail: the front cover and the back cover are removed: they belong in the cover file, and leaving them in prints the cover twice

checks.name: All fonts embedded
checks.detail: every font is embedded: the book's glyphs are outlined as the vector artwork they always were, and the one font left -- the invisible, searchable text layer -- is embedded (guide p.3)

checks.name: No Type 3 glyph-program fonts
checks.detail: none: the Type 3 glyph programs this book was set in are now vector artwork in the page itself (guide p.3)

checks.name: Transparency flattened
checks.detail: no soft masks, transparency groups or blend modes left (guide p.3)

checks.name: Images at 300 DPI or better
checks.detail: 25 below 300 DPI, e.g. page 7: 124 DPI; page 10: 124 DPI; page 12: 1 DPI

checks.name: Master page box fitted to their trim
checks.detail: master page box 210.0 x 297.0 mm matches the trim within a printer's tolerance; no rescaling

checks.name: Artwork covers the printed area
checks.detail: the artwork reaches -0.0 mm past the 210 x 297 mm trim on every visible edge

checks.name: Binding-edge clearance
checks.detail: closest text is 15.1 mm from the left edge on page 59; guide p.3 asks for 20 mm on the gutter, their template prints 17 mm -- this is under even the template's figure

checks.name: No trim or bleed marks
checks.detail: none are drawn, and the media box is exactly trim + bleed (216.00 x 303.00 mm), leaving no room for any

checks.name: Text file is PDF/X-1a:2001 with CMYK
checks.detail: kept RGB: the master sets its text in fonts that cannot be embedded (1 Type 3 glyph programs); the pack outlines those glyphs so BookVault's font check passes, and their preflight converts the RGB (guide p.6)

checks.name: Cover file is a perfect-bound spread
checks.detail: 436.03 x 303.02 mm = back 210 + spine 10 + front 210 + 3 mm bleed, by their p.18 formula

checks.name: Barcode area clear on the back cover
checks.detail: the 38 x 25 mm box their template reserves (6.4 mm in from the right trim, 6.4 mm up) is empty; a barcode is required printing outside the UK

checks.name: Spine width taken from their sizing calculator
checks.detail: built at 10 mm from 175 pages x 0.056 mm per page, rounded up (guide p.18). Run home > help > sizing calculator for the real paper and rebuild with --spine-mm <mm>
